recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the published InM decision without changing endpoint cardinalities or the later endpoint[x] type choice; no separate commits are needed for duplicate Jira issues.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core MessageHeader issue requesting MessageHeader.source.endpoint and MessageHeader.destination.endpoint optionality for real-world V2-derived messaging where endpoint URLs are not always known; InM minutes record the accepted motion also required constraints that source and destination each have one child when present.
initial_application: Historical commit dd765a96be made MessageHeader.destination.endpoint and MessageHeader.source.endpoint 0..1, and later commit cd5098720d changed them to endpoint[x] choices of url or Reference(Endpoint). The current source retained optional endpoints but lacked the approved source/destination child invariants.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists messageheader=MessageHeader and assigns messageheader to InM, placing source/messageheader/structuredefinition-MessageHeader.xml in current build scope. Duplicate Jira issues FHIR-33690, FHIR-32369, FHIR-26898, and FHIR-24921 request the same endpoint optionality. Zulip discussion supports the endpoint optionality use cases and later endpoint[x] implementation details without superseding the InM invariant requirement.
reconciliation: Added msh-1 on MessageHeader.destination requiring endpoint, name, or receiver, and msh-2 on MessageHeader.source requiring endpoint, name, software, version, contact, or sender. Added matching condition references to the involved child elements.
source_changes: source/messageheader/structuredefinition-MessageHeader.xml: added msh-1 and msh-2 constraints plus condition references on the relevant destination and source children.
